o1: Enables cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; cellular response to UV; cellular response to gamma radiation; and proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process. Is located in extracellular region. Is expressed in intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human CTSB (cathepsin B).
